_about: What the Rust replay of model-proxy-host-cases states about itself beyond the generated manifest: which typed field carries each Node field (fieldMap), what is excluded or fixed (declaredExclusions: each with the side it is on, the case, the fields and the reason, read by the recorder like any exclusion of the manifest), what is open, and the replay tests. The recorder merges these into the manifest's `replay` (record-model-proxy-host-cases.mjs); they are kept here so a re-recording writes them itself, and the recorder refuses a declaration that names no recorded case or field (lib/replay-notes.mjs).
replayTests: mixdog-core/src/run_host/model_proxy_host_run_replay_tests.rs drives `modelProxy/run` / `modelProxy/cancel` on ModelProxyService (mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/ai_admin/model_proxy_service.rs, registered by compose_flip.rs) over ProxyRunner, with this PC's PcQuotaProbe, PcWireRouter and PcProviderConfig; mixdog-core/src/run_host/model_proxy_host_config_replay_tests.rs replays the providerConfig cases through PcProviderConfig over the product registry and DefaultProviderBuilder; mixdog-core/src/run_host/model_proxy_host_server_replay_tests.rs replays the server's read (Node loadModelProxyProviderConfig) through HostProxyProviders (mixdog-core/src/run_host/proxy_providers.rs).

failure (one helper: node_failure / type.name: AbortError -> failure.delivery ambiguous and kind transient (cancelled); any other name -> not cancelled
failure (one helper: node_failure / type.props.partialContent: the run's textDelta events before the failure
failure (one helper: node_failure / type.props.name: equal to name

callbacks (one helper: typed_of_callback.[reset, chars]: ProxyEvent::AttemptDiscarded; chars equals the text of the discarded attempt

result.content: the textDelta events after the last AttemptDiscarded
result.settledCalls / hostRunning* / running*: the run's answer (sent or failed) and the run leaving ModelProxyService.runs (close returns)

provider calls.messages / model / tools / options.sessi: the ModelRequest the provider's attempt receives
provider calls.options.toolExecutionSessionId: '': no typed field: no tool executes on the PC

declaredExclusions.reason: Node's claim/event/resolve host (modelProxyClaim/Event/Resolve, its heartbeat, lease and snapshot event) is replaced by the typed modelProxy/run request and its modelProxy/run/event notifications: mixdog-app-protocol/src/inventory.rs:848-858 marks the operations Deleted; the envelope, timers and lease bookkeeping of the replaced protocol; the protections they carried are replayed on the typed path: a run ends with its connection's cancel token (case 7), the frame bound refuses an oversized call before any provider runs (case 19), a provider-config read is bounded by its one-second budget (cases 21/22)

declaredExclusions.case: the PC runs the call with its own provider and streams every callback back in order
declaredExclusions.reason: "Hello again" is the stand-in's literal return (model-proxy-host.test.mjs:172), not what its callbacks streamed after the reset; a typed provider's content is its stream, compared as the text after the discard

declaredExclusions.case: the PC serves only the named provider and the allowed methods
declaredExclusions.reason: forgetCredentials is no ProxyCall variant (mixdog-app-protocol/src/v2/model_proxy.rs ProxyCall): refused as invalid params before anything runs

declaredExclusions.case: the PC reports its model-specific first-response budget through the catalog and provider config
declaredExclusions.reason: a budget that is not a number has no typed form (ProxyBudget is two u64)

declaredExclusions.case: only the requested provider's credential is read, on demand
declaredExclusions.reason: replayed on the real registry (model_proxy_host_config_replay_tests.rs only_the_requested_providers_key_is_read_when_the_request_is_made): a send to openai through the adapter PcProviderConfig serves, with a vault that logs its reads and a transport that keeps the request headers; result.content is the key Node's scripted send returned (openai:<key>), compared with the bearer the adapter sent; keyReads with the vault's reads; anthropicKeyInLastInit with the absence of any anthropic read

declaredExclusions.case: server send options are reduced to the allowlist
declaredExclusions.reason: baseURL, requestHeaders, extraBody, codexInstallationId, _providerSeam are not ProxyOptions fields and are dropped as the call is read

declaredExclusions.case: a proxied side request gets its own transport scope on the PC, disposed when the request ends
declaredExclusions.reason: typed field ProxyOptions.forkedTransportScope (mixdog-app-protocol v2/model_proxy.rs), set by request_out when the sender names a transport scope (model_proxy.rs options_out); the PC allocates <session>#proxy:<uuid> and releases it through ProviderAdapter::release_transport_scope when the run ends (ProxyRunner::run, ProxyCall::Send); the recording's uuids are a scripted counter, so a scope is compared with its uuid replaced by <uuid> and its form asserted; closed (the global close hook) and released (the provider's releaseTransportScope) are one release; replayed by a_forked_side_request_gets_its_own_transport_scope_released_when_it_ends

declaredExclusions.case: a proxied side request gets its own transport scope on the PC, disposed when the request ends
declaredExclusions.reason: Node's rejection of a cancelled side request is the abort reason of the server's own signal ("user stop"), not this PC's; the PC's part, the run ending as a cancellation with its scope released, is compared

declaredExclusions.case: a call payload over the request cap is refused before any provider runs
declaredExclusions.reason: Node's 200-byte cap was the test host's option; the typed bound is Limits::max_inbound_frame_bytes, checked by decode_inbound_text

declaredExclusions.case: provider config deadline aborts a stalled request (claimed=false)
declaredExclusions.reason: a read's budget is one second for every read (proxy_providers.rs WAIT), not chosen per caller

declaredExclusions.case: provider config deadline aborts a stalled request (claimed=true)
declaredExclusions.reason: a read's budget is one second for every read (proxy_providers.rs WAIT), not chosen per caller

declaredExclusions.case: forced and short-budget reads do not join an older request or let it overwrite the fresh cache
declaredExclusions.reason: no per-read budget exists, so two unforced reads join one request (1, not Node's 2 more)

declaredExclusions.case: all built-in provider families and custom protocols use the same PC catalog and send path
declaredExclusions.reason: recorded twice (golden cases 24 and 24b): the recorder gates the registry init and the credential probe on the stored Developer options through Node's own developerOptionEnabled / developerOptionForProvider (src/runtime/shared/developer-options.mjs), once with none stored (mimo-oauth, cursor-oauth, antigravity-oauth never admitted, authState absent) and once with the three on; both states are built from the core (the world's config carries the same developer section; the three sign-in files the real adapters need are the ones a login leaves) and compared whole
